steps.title: Required frontmatter
steps.note: A SKILL.md manifest must declare name, version, description, tools, and entrypoint. The registry rejects any skill missing these fields.

steps.title: Progressive disclosure
steps.note: The skill can surface only create_presentation initially and reveal add_slide once the user wants to edit an existing deck. This limits blast radius for new skills.

steps.title: Instruction body
steps.note: The markdown body explains expected inputs, outputs, and behavior. Treat it as the system prompt for the skill: concrete, scoped, and reviewable.
